## Checklist

- [ ] Target branch is correct (`develop` for normal work).
- [ ] The issue is linked with `Closes #N` or `Refs #N`.
- [ ] Semantic tests cover the changed behavior.
- [ ] Defect fixes include a regression test.
- [ ] Factual documentation claims have evidence/probes where practical.
- [ ] Ddoc and documented `unittest` examples are updated for public API changes.
- [ ] Performance-relevant changes include current benchmark evidence.
- [ ] No new `@trusted` scope lacks a concise safety justification.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated for user-visible changes.
- [ ] Toolchain workarounds are registered when applicable.
- [ ] Package/release metadata is updated when applicable.
